genealogy.lineage_statement: The reciprocal comparison scaffold is rooted at bare <=>. The affix-position forms <=>_r and r_<=> are projection descendants of that scaffold within the bridge-comparison line. The closure forms <=>_R and <=>_{ra} remain separate closure-family members. Family membership records operator-lineage class; projection descent records a scaffolded variant inside that class.
genealogy.non_ancestry_rule: This genealogy does not make any of the listed operators primitive-form ancestors, and it does not make projection descendants interchangeable with closure-family members.
forbidden_readings: closure family membership as proof of primitive-form ancestry
projection descent as proof of semantic identity

audited_occurrences.reading: The affix-position test and operator family scope already separate the bridge-comparison variants from the closure family, so the genealogy can be stated as a lineage relation rather than as a primitive-form claim.
The canonical lexicon already records <=>_r and r_<=> as separate promoted terms sourced from the affix-position test campaign.

resolved_here: separation of closure-family membership from projection descent
not_resolved_here: primitive-form ancestry claims for the comparison operators
promotion of the affix-position test terms beyond provisional status
